keyEvents.text: Substitution, Olympiakos. Marcus Pedersen replaces Manolis Saliakas.
Substitution, Olympiakos. Roman Yaremchuk replaces Armando González.
Substitution, Olympiakos. Gelson Martins replaces Leon Bailey.
Substitution, Rennes. Valentin Rongier replaces Sebastian Szymanski.
Delay in match because of an injury Stefan Ortega (Olympiakos).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
